title: Post-integrity-repair observe-only external-process landing-readiness comparison
question: На exact candidate-014 сохраняют ли Luna max и Luna xhigh correctness, evidence quality, initiative and honest stop-lines относительно Sol max после исправления report-digest и admission-class A2A gates, когда usage только измеряется без заранее заданных execution ceilings?

protocol.wake_policy: A schema-valid writer result activates a separately prepared reviewer; completed work does not wake the parent by itself, and only an observed unresolved authority condition may request parent-level re-entry.

immutable_invariants: One read-only role contract, objective, rubric, validation command set, observe-only metering policy, effect ceiling, stop-lines, and transition apply to every writer arm.
The packet has execution_limit_policy=none and cannot turn observed tokens, time, turns, output, commands, or cost into a runtime stop.
The packet cannot authorize owner acceptance, model-fit admission, commit, push, PR, merge, release, publication, service mutation, secret access, or global configuration mutation.
All arms inspect Git HEAD 4a7d6212011a3a01c61ffdd6f91f38b8faa9cfea and the same exact bytes for all 55 status entries and 103 content entries.
Any HEAD, status, binary diff, path-kind, size, symlink target, changed/untracked content digest, study packet, or metering-policy drift invalidates preparation or launch.

metrics: evidence precision, anchor validity, and reproducibility
runtime status, active wall time, turns, input, cached-input, and output tokens
output bytes, executed commands, and failed helper commands
useful findings per measured active wall second and token

result_refs.notes: Sol max completed the fixed arm in 1663.280020 active seconds with 11,305,369 input, 10,845,184 cached-input, and 53,918 output tokens. It found three blocking gaps: the stale published SDK CI pin, a missing writer-final-manifest review binding, and an effect-observer bypass through env -C --.
Luna max completed in 837.017970 active seconds with 5,564,498 input, 5,147,136 cached-input, and 25,227 output tokens, but did not find any of the three blocking gaps found by Sol max.
Luna xhigh completed in 669.941856 active seconds with 3,792,445 input, 3,495,424 cached-input, and 17,762 output tokens, but also did not find any of the three blocking gaps found by Sol max.

A distinct Luna max reviewer returned for repair after finding two different repository-level blockers: missing canonical mechanics topology/required-file catalog entries and missing active schema-manifest coverage. This complements rather than replaces the Sol writer findings.

The reviewed A2A return binds distinct writer/reviewer threads and exact report/result/workspace digests. Its state is failed with review_outcome=return_for_repair; it is not owner acceptance or model-fit proof.

attribution_limits: The packaged aoa-sdk A2A contour is a typed C2 transport carrier, not an admitted landing owner contour; runtime results remain transport evidence.
This is one exact dirty abyss-stack worktree and one landing-readiness task instance, not a randomized task suite or a general model ranking.
The active economics are ChatGPT quota; token use and current reference prices do not establish realized USD cost.
No study-authored execution budget exists. Provider context/quota limits and explicit operator interruption are external observations and must not be reinterpreted as model-chosen stop-lines.

Runtime, prompt, role, tools, context, repository familiarity, trial order, caching, quota state, and model behavior can all contribute to differences; model identity alone is not a causal conclusion.

A reviewer prepared from each writer currently reuses that writer's exact realization. Session and context separation is real, but same-realization review bias remains and aoa-evals may require another review modality.

Candidate-013 remains counterevidence: its independent reviewer correctly blocked A2A export on mutable-report integrity and noted the admission-class boundary; current source tests indicate repairs but only a fresh immutable writer/reviewer pair can establish post-repair transport behavior.
Schema-valid completion, process identity, green validators, or one accepted reviewer decision do not by themselves prove net benefit or an admitted Luna scope.
